title: Azazel's Realm (Miao and Azazel campaigns)
author: Kerberos 2
description:
Get The Mod On Steam: Expand the Required mods 💚 section below. Steam mods are unlisted, so you must come to this LoversLab page to get the link to them!!!

The @@Compendium_Play_as_Azazel_Overwrite is still included on this page, see Recommended mods 💛

Join discord: <https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk>

Feedback and questions about the mod are best left in Lazy's Discord. You can also Subscribe to "Kerberos's Projects" under "Channels & Roles" to get a ping when updates release.

Play as Azazel in a new campaign. Be the catalyst for both Miao and Katarin's fall to corruption through an expansive quest chain relating to each Lord, culminating in a combined event at the end. The quest chain will present the option to confederate these powerful women into Azazel's personal harem, or leave them autonomy as your allies or vassals. Features full integration with Lazy's corruption progression for both Miao and Katarin. Take note, Azazel has a very easy campaign already, and this mod will bless the player with even more tools and bonuses. In return, traps have been laid to make for a more challenging campaign. If you are expecting an easy victory as Azazel, the Changeling may have other plans...

Play as Miao Ying and resist or succumb to Azazel's efforts to turn you to Slaanesh. Should you fall to corruption, you will have the opportunity to aid Azazel in converting your former ally, Tzarina Katarin of Kislev, as well.

The mod is set up to function with the player as Archaon, Belakor, Sigvald, or Daemon Prince (Daemons of Chaos) who all auto confederate Azazel turn 1.

The player as N'Kari, Morathi, is no longer supported as of this latest update, I did this to make way for the custom Morathi and N'kari starting options that I am adding to Alarielle Temptation's bloom. You will eventually still be able to experience Azazel's Realm as N'kari/Morathi, but their story will FIRST be focused on Alarielle's route.

For those who want to know more about the content included, a LUA cheat sheet and flow chart for both campaigns is included in the downloads, though for obvious reasons the mod's content will be best enjoyed by experiencing it naturally in a fresh campaign.

첨부파일에는 플로우 차트공략을 통해서 어떤 식으로 퀘스트가 진행되는지 알 수 있고. LUA 치트시트 또한 첨부되어 명령어를 입력해서 이벤트를 즉시 발생시키는 것이 가능합니다. 물론 가능한 한 자연스럽게 켐페인을 플레이 하면서 모드를 즐기시는 편이 가장 최고의 경험을 얻을 수 있을 것입니다.

在新战役中扮演阿扎泽尔。通过与两位领主相关的庞大任务链，成为妙影和卡塔琳堕落的催化剂，并在最后的联合行动中走向顶峰。在任务链中，您可以选择将这些强大的女性纳入阿扎泽尔的个人后宫，也可以让她们作为您的盟友或附庸享有自主权。妙影和卡塔琳的堕落进程与Lazy的堕落进程完全整合。

扮演妙影，抵制或向阿扎泽尔屈服从而成为为色孽的仆从。如果您堕落了，您将有机会帮助阿扎泽尔将您的前盟友女沙皇卡捷琳也转化为色孽。

如果您想了解更多有关内容的信息，下载中包含了两个战役的脚本小抄和流程图，不过出于显而易见的原因，您最好还是在一个全新的战役中自然地体验 MOD 的内容。

友情提示：如果你选择使用的派系是卡捷琳（基斯里夫），并且想体验Lazy做的腐化流程，那么请关闭阿扎泽尔相关的腐化mod。因为它重写了原本的任务逻辑，导致事件无法正常触发。而且当你扮演卡捷琳时，阿扎泽尔mod中并没有任何有关事件，所以放心关。

Features

-
Scenes featuring 110!!! pieces of art (unique+variations) and one video from the incredibly talented SOBORO.

-
Branching quest chains featuring multiple routes. Meeting the right conditions will allow confederation of Azazel by Miao, and vice versa.

-
Three custom quest battles featuring advanced mechanics such as voiced dialogue and cinematic camera events.

-
Voiced dialogue in some scenes! Most spliced from game audio files, some AI generated!

-
Immortal Empires portals (opened via corruption event) connecting Miao/Azazel and eventually N'Kari

-
A quest to revive N'Kari's faction when he inevitably dies in Ulthuan!

-
100% compatible with Azazel or Miao confederated by another faction. (other than each other). Designed with play as Archaon confederating Azazel in mind.

-
Bonus scenes including Sigvald, Greasus, and Yuan Bo.

Recommended mods 💛 + load order

[[SPOILER]]

here is my full recommended mod list and load order for playing a lewd campaign as Miao, Azazel (or confederating Azazel), Alarielle, and Katarin.

(hint: I never manually changed any load order) This is now linking to the wiki so I only have to update it in one place. 🙏I beg you to look at it, it's beautiful and I guarantee it will help you.🙏

<https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/File:Mod_list_and_load_order.png>

For Play as Both/Either

Highly recommend Corrupted Compendium <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3705392682> - This is unlisted on steam so you can only access it through this link.

Passing's Corrupted Valkia isn't needed for the first 90% of a playthrough of Azazel's Realm, but if you have it enabled at the time Azazel's Realm's Valkia endgame crisis is completed, you will get some special treats, including access to the custom Locephax lord and being able to view Passing's scenes related to Valkia's final fall to Slaanesh. It has been very fun to collaborate with Passing on a crossover event like this.

Both versions work with the "Immortal Empires Expanded" mod.

For Play as Azazel (and as another faction confederating Azazel, including when starting as Alarielle)

the "@@Compendium_Play_as_Azazel_Overwrite" included in this download is what enables natural Corrupted Compendium integration when playing as Azazel. When this is used, compendium scenes will start playing once Miao is either confederated or allied/vassalized via the Azazel mod quest chain. The emissary and scenes will start at tier 2, because Miao is already fairly corrupted, and the compendium final quest battles will be playable with Azazel. You must disable this specific file if starting as Miao!

Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom - This is unlisted on steam so you can only access it through this link.

<https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3644437727>

DO NOT USE IF PLAYING AS Miao Ying, highly recommended for playing as Azazel.

For Play as Miao,

I consider it mandatory that you use either one or both of the below to be able to progress Miao's corruption in a natural way.

"Slaanesh Assaults The Great Bastion" Replaces Kurgans with a Slaaneshi Warband. Fully compatible with this mod, and the Slaaneshi Warband will even be a part of this mod's quest battle. <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2851864965>

Another option is the "Miao Ying vs Slaanesh (Immortal Empires start positions)" Mod by me that swaps start positions to bring the three Slaaneshi Legendary Lords closer to Miao Ying. I recommend using this mod only if not using "Slaanesh assaults the great bastion", but you must use the Mod Configuration Tool (MCT) options to turn the Azazel swap off. The Azazel mod is designed for Azazel being in his vanilla start position. <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2860381227>

[[/SPOILER]]

NOT Recommended mods 💔

[[SPOILER]]

Corrupted Ascension - Sad to say Lin decided to make their own corruption framework to try and overcome the shortcomings of Lazy's. The result is Lin's mods are now completely incompatible with anything that relies on Lazy's Framework, which is most of the mods on my recommended list.

Miao Ying vs Slaanesh face off (campaign balance) - Do NOT use the (campaign balance) mod if you are playing as Miao. It will make Azazel too strong for you to be able to sign an alliance with him without cheating in console. You could use this mod for play as Azazel if you want Miao Ying's faction to be on steroids. The start position version of "Miao Ying vs Slaanesh" is fine but I recommend you use Mod Config Tool (MCT) to turn off the Azazel start position swap.

Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords (RDLL) - Turn off AI recruitment if used! There are many functions in Temptation's Bloom and Azazel's Realm that this will break.

SFO Confirmed cause of CTD on Miao/Azazel quest battle, let me know if you have more data.

Legendary Characters by Stratovarius - Causes script breaks visible with context viewer. These will silently softlock all corruption progression.

Allegiance of the damned: Chaos confederation - Do not use this or other mods that enable Azazel to be confederated diplomatically. There is a good chance some quest progression will break if Azazel is confederated, though I scripted the mod to check for Azazel and not his faction wherever possible, quest objectives won't dynamically shift if his AI faction is confederated mid quest.

[DEER24/震旦] 与龙同行 (Cathay Units Patch：Walk with the Dragon) - Causes script breaks apparent from turn 1 with context viewer.

Playing Lazy's Progression as Tzarina Katarin - Azazel's Realm has no content for play as Katarin so don't leave it (or Valkia) enabled when playing as Katarin.

Just Good Battle UI - causes the game to crash when entering a manual battle with Miao, if, and only if, she's corrupted.

Helper UI - same as "Just Good Battle UI" and Confirmed cause of CTD on Miao/Azazel quest battle.

[[/SPOILER]]

How to start the mod. ✔️

[[SPOILER]]

For play as Miao: The mod's content begins with a quest chain starting one turn after the player reaches Corruption stage 2 from Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression.

For play as Azazel: You will see two incidents and be issued two quests (one for each target lord) at the start of your 2nd turn. You will know Lazy's Corruption Progression is working if you see a dilemma on turn 10 informing you that Miao has been offered corruption stage 1.

Player as Archaon, Belakor, Sigvald, Daemon Prince (Daemons of Chaos): Turn 1 instantly confederates Azazel. You will be issued the same quests as Azazel at the start of your 2nd turn. Archaon, Belakor, and Sigvald now have 100% feature parity with starting as Azazel, and you can even use Katarin's split Tzeentch and Slaanesh authority if you play as any of them. Player as Daemon Prince (Daemons of Chaos) is NOT the recommended way to play, as you won't get the corrupted unit warband upgrades and the names for Katarin, Miao, and Locephax will all blank if confederated, but it is here as a decent option.

The player as N'Kari, Morathi, is now only supported if you also use my Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom mod. You can still experience Azazel's Realm as N'kari/Morathi, but their story will FIRST be focused on Alarielle's route.

For confirmation that the mod has initiated properly, on turn 1 you can check the Kerberos_mod_log.txt located at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III

HOW TO PROGRESS MIAO'S CORRUPTION OTHER THAN BATTLES

Miao's corruption will progress slowly based on the number of diplomatic deals she has with any Slaanesh or Warriors of Chaos Factions. If you have Vassalized her, then having Miao and Azazel (or N'Kari) end the turn in the same region will trigger a progression, this still has the 3 turn cooldown. Check the li_log.txt file if you want to confirm that Miao is building points towards diplomatic progression.

[[/SPOILER]]

Starting map changes (the "Campaign" part) 🗺️

[[SPOILER]]

This mod makes quite a few alterations to the starting balance of the game at campaign start. I wanted to keep these mostly secret but people often discover and ask about them so I am finally documenting them here. These changes are made with three primary goals in mind:

#1, Ensure that Azazel/Kat/Miao don't get wiped out by their AI enemies or each other before the player gets to interact with them as needed to complete the quest chains. This includes some protections for Ogre Kingdoms and generic Cathay factions, as they need to exist for the diplomacy side quest chain also.

#2, Maintain a loreful and interesting challenge for the player. This is so that when you complete the primary quest chains as Azazel or Maio, and have these strong (arguably overpowered) corrupted champions and items at your disposal, your final enemy will be a united and strong ordertide, which is a much more interesting "endgame" scenario than conquering an old world already ruined by Chaos/Skaven/Norsca/Vamps, or an Ulthuan already dominated by N'kari/Dark Elves/Vampire Coast.

#3 Maintain faction diversity for enemies and bring more relevant Legendary Lords into the opposing forces likely to be fought in the campaign.

Player is any recommended factions start: Miao, Azazel, Archaeon, Belakor, Sigvald DaemonPrince. (see Alarielle mod page for Alarielle, Morathi, and Daemons of Slaanesh)

Valkia is removed from the game, in order to bring her back in a controlled fashion for the endgame crisis.

buff to Katarin's starting province. (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Confederate and abandon starting province for: Azhag to Wurzag. (done in service of goal #1)

Nerf the starts for Thrott, Ikit Claw, Grimgore. (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Confederate and abandon starting province for: Skarsnik to Grom, Alberic to Fey Enchantress, Grombindal to Thorgrim, Wulfhart to Franz, Kemmler to Vlad. (done in service of goal #2 and #3)

Vlad is postured to behave as a neutral partner to the empire rather than an enemy. (done in service of goal #2 and #3)

Nerf to N'Kari's start, buff to Alarielle's start. If N'Kari conquers Ulthuan (and he can now with CA's random potential rolls) then the player as Miao or Azazel are denied the opportunity for a fun endgame quest and goal. (done in service of goal #2)

Player is Miao start:

Buff Azazel's start, and nerf Kostaltyn's start, confederate Malakai Makaisson to Karak Kadrin. Arbaal to Archaon (done in service of goal #1)

Player is Azazel start: Azazel, Archaeon, Belakor, Sigvald, DaemonPrince. (Also includes Temptation's Bloom start for Alarielle, Daemons of Slaanesh, Morathi)

Buff to Miao's start. (done in service of goal #1)

Sayl is confederated to Wulfrick and removed from Bastion area. (done in service of goal #1)

Vilitch is confederated to Kairos and start abandoned. This is to help AI Miao survive, and so that the player Azazel can occupy Vilitch's starting position when the mod's portal to it is opened. (done in service of goal #1)

Zhatan confederated to other Chaos Dwarf and start abandoned. (done in service of goal #1)

Yuan Bo start moved to central Cathay (done in service of goal #1 and #2)

Volkmar confederated to Franz (done in service of goal #2 and #3)

Known issues / Troubleshooting 🛠️

[[SPOILER]]

TROUBLESHOOTING

If you encounter unexpected behavior, please report it in the "azazel-realm" submod channel on the discord for troubleshooting steps if having an issue.

if you do not encounter expected behavior, Then please do the below for script troubleshooting (everyone should do this)

1) enable PJ's console from at <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2791241084> Console Commands (Modding Tool)

Check the box in game options for "Enable context viewer"

[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2025_03/image.png.b56e9e1f25a28c70e97c7c83b7d9d9e9.png]

doing this will show script breaking errors in game for you as red text in the top left of the screen. Take a picture of these if you want help fixing your play-through.

PJ's console will also generate a log file called script_log_###.txt located at your install location such as C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III

Search this log file for: BIG FAT SCRIPT ERROR to identify what mods are breaking scripting for your game.

KNOWN ISSUES

Corrupted Characters Stage Reset: You are using too many script heavy mods. run this bug fix mod with your modlist and load a save before they reset to stage 0. <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3509062568>

Confederation Names: Confederated corrupted Miao will lose her name. This has been a known issue with Lazy's corruption series and unfortunately would be very tricky to address due to how the game categorizes names by culture. There is a fix submod for this pinned in my discord channel you can enable after confederating Miao.

Azazel warband upgrade UI is messed up if playing in ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio: I play in 21:9 myself and have spent a lot of time trying to fix this to no success. If anyone can give me a fix for this I will paypall you $15.😭 Previously using the legacy version of Warband Upgrades Ultimate mod fixed this but no longer.

Slaanesh and Tzeentch Authority for Miao and Kat: When confederating either of them as a Warrior of Chaos faction, you must trigger a first tick (load game or manual battle) after the confederation, and then end turn once. On the next turn their authority will show and take effect correctly.

Quest Battle black screen on start: This has been reported by a few users. Re-load a quick save or auto save just before the battle, and it is reported to always work the 2nd time after reloading. If you want to find what other mod is breaking lua scripting for you (and you should or more issues will arise) then follow the above steps for using PJ's console to check for script errors.

Mission to defeat Katarin with Azazel's army not completing:

This has the same cause as the quest battle issue because the fix is the same. (reload the save right before fighting to restore lua scripting). please try the troubleshooting step above to identify what mod is breaking lua scripting.

No quest battle spawns if Azazel's faction is wiped out:

Playing as Miao, If Azazel's faction is wiped out before you hit corruption stage 2, the first "investigate" quest will still spawn, but after completing it, the quest battle will not spawn. This is unlikely to happen as the mod now gives Azazel an extra Dark Fortress to start off with. The same issue would apply to the Changeling quest battle in the Katarin quest chain if you devote yourself to exterminating the Changeling before triggering the battle. The AI isn't able to wipe out the Changeling that I have seen.
